subject.title: [Feature]: Add a pre-effect hook for resolved nested tool operations

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee a new resolved-operation, pre-effect plugin authorization contract across exec, nodes, MCP, and plugin-owned effects, and if so which operation kinds and harnesses are in its first supported coverage set?
rationale: This is a new security-sensitive plugin API whose completeness, fail-closed behavior, scoping, and compatibility guarantees cannot be selected safely from local implementation details alone.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped API design
options.body: Approve a design issue or RFC that defines the first operation taxonomy, supported owners, redaction rules, retry identity, and Pi/Codex coverage before code changes begin.

options.title: Keep top-level authorization only
options.body: Decline a generic resolved-operation guarantee and direct specialized policy needs to owner-specific tools or plugin contracts.

options.title: Stage one owner path first
options.body: Approve a narrowly documented pilot for one operation family, without claiming generic coverage until the remaining owners are designed and tested.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped API design
recommendation.body: Approve a design issue or RFC that defines the first operation taxonomy, supported owners, redaction rules, retry identity, and Pi/Codex coverage before code changes begin.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue asks for this owner's confirmation and the request changes OpenClaw's public security and plugin-extension direction.
